name: mcp
description: MCP tool invoke, read, and result use. Each scenario launches a real host agent.

scenarios.name: echoes through MCP
scenarios.prompt: Call the echo MCP tool with text "agent-test-mcp-echo-ok-1a7c". Reply with the exact tool result. Do not use Shell or Bash.

scenarios.name: reads a note through MCP
scenarios.prompt: Call the lookup MCP tool with id "alpha". Reply with the exact note text. Do not guess. Do not use Shell or Bash.
